title: Exact lattice resonances and a sharp second Picard obstruction for the two-dimensional inviscid primitive equations
summary: We study periodic perturbations of a rest state with constant stable stratification for the two-dimensional non-rotating primitive equations without viscosity or thermal diffusion on a fixed rectangular torus. Fourier resonance analysis and Sobolev estimates show that, despite unitary linear evolution, the polarized second Picard operator admits no bilinear bound losing less than one derivative at any Sobolev order and any fixed nonzero time for real data with zero vertical means.
